label: 静态预览
description: 把 SceneSpec（来自 g_to_scene）推送到内嵌 3D 预览器进行静态可视化。前端 live-sync 拉取本节点 sceneSpec 输出，命中即切 static 模式（逐条加载 <sha>.obj/.glb → 应用 origin/rpy/scale + 材质 → 组合成静态场景）。sceneSpec 端口透传，便于继续接线。
description-en: Forward a SceneSpec (from g_to_scene) to the embedded 3D viewer for static preview. The frontend live-sync pulls this node's sceneSpec output and switches to static mode (load each <sha>.obj/.glb → apply origin/rpy/scale + material → compose a static scene). Pass-through for chaining.
